name: @anvilkit/agent-model-proxy
description: Controlled Model Proxy of the AnvilKit Agent platform (DD-03 §2/§6, B05, delivery.md P11): the sole holder of model provider credentials; every physical send needs its own single-use AdmitModel permission from Control, goes through one guarded transport with transparent retries, fallback and redirects disabled, is normalized into the frozen StreamFrame contract, and leaves private native evidence and an idempotent usage observation behind.
